title: Symmetry and Monotonicity of y = 1 / |x|
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Describe the graph of y = 1 / |x|, state its symmetry, and find the intervals on which the function is increasing and decreasing.
finalAnswer: \text{Symmetric about the } y\text{-axis; Increasing on } (-\infty, 0); \text{ Decreasing on } (0, \infty)

steps.title: Determine Domain and Even Symmetry
steps.explanation: The function is defined for all x != 0, and since |-x| = |x|, it is an even function whose graph is symmetric about the y-axis.
steps.why: Absolute value is an even function, so its reciprocal 1/|x| is also even.

steps.title: Analyze Behavior on (0, inf)
steps.explanation: For x > 0, y = 1/x decreases from +infinity toward 0 as x increases.
steps.why: The reciprocal of a positive increasing variable is strictly decreasing.

steps.title: Analyze Behavior on (-inf, 0)
steps.explanation: For x < 0, as x increases toward 0^-, |x| = -x decreases toward 0^+, so 1/|x| increases from 0^+ toward +infinity. Thus the function increases on (-inf, 0) and decreases on (0, inf).
steps.why: By y-axis symmetry, a function that decreases on (0, inf) must increase on (-inf, 0).
